description: A two-output oscillator with a band-pass filter, a wavefolder and a drive stage, switchable between a pair of tonal waveforms and a pair of harsh ones

params.text: Chooses which pair of waveforms the two outputs carry: sin/saw gives a sine and a sawtooth, rect/rand gives a rectangle and a random wave stepping at the oscillator rate
Sets the oscillator pitch, 20Hz to 2000Hz, with the travel spread evenly across octaves rather than across hertz
Sets the centre frequency of the band-pass filter, 20Hz to 20000Hz
Sets the resonance of the band-pass filter, a wide peak at the far left and a sharp one at the far right
Sets the gain applied after the filter and before the folder, 0 to 10000 on a curve that spreads the quiet end across more of the travel
Sets how hard the signal is folded back on itself after the gain stage, none at the far left
Sets the saturation added after the folder, none at the far left
Sets the level leaving the module, silent at the far left and twice unity at the far right
Scales the voltage arriving at the freq jack, -1 to +1, and it comes up fully open so a sequencer plays the module as soon as it is patched
Scales the voltage arriving at the cutoff jack, -1 to +1, with nothing getting through at the centre
Scales the voltage arriving at the gain jack, -1 to +1, with nothing getting through at the centre
Scales the voltage arriving at the fold jack, -1 to +1, with nothing getting through at the centre
Scales the voltage arriving at the volume jack, -1 to +1, with nothing getting through at the centre

inputs.text: Shifts the pitch at 1V per octave around the frequency the freq knob sets, scaled by its trim
Shifts the filter centre frequency, scaled by its trim
Shifts the filter resonance, with no trim of its own
Shifts the gain after the filter, scaled by its trim
Shifts the folding amount, scaled by its trim
Shifts the saturation, with no trim of its own
Shifts the output level, scaled by its trim

outputs.text: The first waveform of the chosen pair, after the filter, folder, drive and level stages
The second waveform of the chosen pair, after the filter, folder, drive and level stages

notes: the module sounds as soon as it is placed and needs no gate; the signal runs oscillator, filter, folder, drive, level in that order
three of the CV jacks have a trim of their own and three do not; the cutoff, gain, fold and volume jacks and the pitch jack are trimmed, the Q and drive jacks go straight in
one lamp follows the oscillator frequency on a logarithmic scale and the other follows whichever of the two outputs is the louder

inputs.0:
1V per octave · continuous
